entities.name: Thexar
entities.description: An Anaba minotaur of Ulgrotha who died in a ritual scarring ceremony gone wrong.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane of the Anaba minotaurs.

entities.name: Neth'arna
entities.description: The inexperienced minotaur who oversaw Thexar's scarring ceremony.

entities.name: Anaba
entities.description: The minotaur people to which Thexar belonged.

events.summary: Thexar led his group to their ancestral caverns with his navigational skill.
events.quote: Thexar played a crucial role in leading his group to their ancestral caverns

events.summary: Thexar underwent a scarring ceremony overseen by the inexperienced Neth'arna, which proved fatal.
events.quote: overseen by the inexperienced Neth'arna , ultimately proved fatal

events.summary: Thexar died pleading for death and accusing Neth'arna; the minotaur workers abandoned their tasks to mourn.
events.quote: The collective response of the minotaur workers, who abandoned their tasks to mourn Thexar

relations.quote: Thexar was an Anaba minotaur from Ulgrotha

relations.note: Thexar died in the ceremony she oversaw and accused Neth'arna of betrayal.
relations.quote: overseen by the inexperienced Neth'arna , ultimately proved fatal
